preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ab' for c in s) and all(c in 'ab' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both input strings s and t consist only of the characters 'a' and 'b'.
The lengths of s and t are between 1 and 200,000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: any(c == 'a' for c in s) and any(c == 'b' for c in t)
preconditions.description: At least one 'a' exists in s and at least one 'b' exists in t (or vice versa, as per the problem guarantee).

postconditions.expression: all(c == 'a' for c in s_final) or all(c == 'b' for c in s_final) and all(c == 'a' for c in t_final) or all(c == 'b' for c in t_final)
postconditions.description: After performing the operations, one of the strings (s or t) consists entirely of 'a's and the other entirely of 'b's.

postconditions.expression: n == len(operations) and all(0 <= a <= len(s) and 0 <= b <= len(t) for a, b in operations)
postconditions.description: The first line of output is an integer n (number of operations), followed by n lines of space-separated integers (a_i, b_i), where a_i and b_i are valid prefix lengths for s and t, respectively.
The number of operations n is between 0 and 500,000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'ab' for c in s_final) and all(c in 'ab' for c in t_final)
postconditions.description: The final strings s_final and t_final consist only of 'a' and 'b' characters (inherited from input constraints).
